verdict.rationale: RevenueCat is a configurable SaaS platform. It offers remotely configured paywalls and offerings, webhooks, scheduled exports, and MCP/AI-toolkit configuration, so asking whether you can version and roll back these automations is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence shows version history, change review/approval, or rollback for any of these. Remote publishing of paywalls is not evidence of versioning or rollback.
